[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I can sense Dickson.[XENO:n ]
We must be near the top.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

If we proceed from here,[XENO:n ]
we will be unable to return.[XENO:n ]
Are you ready to go on?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Do you want to go on?
No, I need more time.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I understand. We'll be ready.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
